text: Chime says SpotMe has no overdraft fees, no interest, and no minimum balance fees, and you can optionally tip. To qualify, you generally need to receive a qualifying direct deposit into your Chime Checking Account. Your limit starts small, often around $20, and can grow over time based on your account activity. Other Chime fees, such as out-of-network ATM charges, may still apply, and terms can change, so check Chime's website or app for the latest details.
